input.summary:
Bakehouse (Backhaus) furnished in parts/room-3.mjs: kneading trough (cauldrons) on the west wall, a fence-and-slab work table on the east wall, flour barrels and hay sacks at both ends, a wood stack by the side door, and a lit smoker beside the oven mouth at (18,2,21).
Column x=19 stays clear as the lane from the shop doorway to the oven mouth and side door; 20 blocks placed, no refused writes, no off-palette blocks in this part.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt. `mcd room` says OK: 23 of 24 floor cells reachable, min light 10, no dark cells. `mcd check` is clean for this room.
left: Plan.md's checklist has no room rows and elements.md's interior item covers all six rooms, so I did not tick it; the coordinator should tick it once every room is built.

The eye view from the shop door (render --eye 18,2,15) shows the lit smoker and the wood stack. The bakehouse has no hanging lanterns: the 3-wide room has no solid block above its floor to hang from, so the light comes from two standing lanterns and the lit smoker.
The floor cell (18,4,14) on top of the flour sack is reported as unreachable. It is a cell on top of a hay block, not a floor cell a player can use, so this is noise, not a fault.

waste.what: Drew the bakehouse furniture as a 3x8 character grid for two floor layers and wrote the legend by hand.
waste.cost: about 8 minutes of drafting rows and checking which column is the lane; the room is narrow enough that a manual layout was quick
waste.tool: A `mcd room` mode that proposes furniture rows for a narrow room (keeps a lane along one column, lanterns where the light is dark) would have saved this step.

waste.what: Wrote a one-off render command to get an interior view, because `mcd rooms --out` only gives the from-above view for this room (it is under 5 wide, so no eye view).
waste.cost: one extra render call and a Read of the image
waste.tool: `mcd rooms --out` should add an eye view from the entrance for narrow rooms, or cut the roof above the room's top so the from-above view shows the furniture.

waste.what: Checked the room's light by reading the level grid, and the roof-line and smoke by eye from the shop-door render.
waste.cost: two renders and a read-through of the level grid
waste.tool: `mcd room` already prints the light grid; a single combined card (floor, light, one interior eye view) would avoid the separate render.
